our_argument_summary: The dome cites the 2009 Chinese SG-network null as confirming the model; applying the dome's own kappa = 1.677 nT/uGal to documented eclipse-magnetic perturbations (5-15 nT) predicts a 3-9 uGal contact-phase pulse the network did not record. New since c13: EXP-618 closes the final defender retreat (network insensitivity) by showing the sensitivity defense proves too much — kappa's denominator (the 6.5 uGal Mohe anomaly) was measured on a single LaCoste-Romberg spring (D-122, 2-3 uGal precision, +/-3-4 uGal band per the authors), so discarding 2009 spring data discards kappa first; and the original research group's own 2002 reanalysis and 2013 weather attribution withdrew the founding signal.

holes_found.description: The load-bearing instrument figure for the seven 2009 spring gravimeters — 'post-fit residual floors of approximately 1-2 uGal' — is uncited, and the new EXP-618 paragraph itself now quotes the SAME instrument class (LaCoste-Romberg spring) at '2-3 uGal precision and a residual noise band of +/-3-4 uGal' from Wang et al. 2000. A defender quotes our own paragraph back at us: 'by your own sourced numbers, LCR springs sit at +/-3-4 uGal; your unsourced 1-2 uGal floor for the 2009 springs is contradicted by the only LCR dataset you actually cite.' The derived '4-25x below the prediction' multiplier inherits the uncited premise.
holes_found.recommendation: Re-anchor the spring floor to the defense's own source: even adopting Wang et al. 2000's worst-case +/-3-4 uGal single-instrument band, coherent stacking across 8 instruments puts the network floor at ~1.1-1.4 uGal, still 2-8x below the 3-9 uGal prediction (and Wang's own 10-min-smoothed uncertainties of +/-1.4 uGal show a single spring reaches ~1.4 uGal after routine averaging). Every number then comes from the paper the defender must rely on. Alternatively cite Crossley, Hinderer & Riccardi 2013 or the 2013 CJG record for the 1-2 uGal post-fit figure if it can be sourced.

holes_found.description: Selective sigma quotation now exposed by the primary source: our text states the Mohe dips are 'a 2.4-2.6 sigma excursion' (6.0/2.5, 7.0/2.7 — accurate for the raw-data values), but Wang et al. 2000's full text ALSO reports smoothed-curve values of 5.3 +/- 1.4 and 6.8 +/- 1.4 uGal (~3.8 and ~4.9 sigma). A defender armed with the paper we link can claim we quoted only the weakest significance numbers.
holes_found.recommendation: Acknowledge and dispose in one clause: the higher smoothed-curve sigmas come from a 10-minute moving average that the paper itself concedes makes 'the signal looks more significant', and sigma computed on autocorrelated smoothed residuals is inflated; the raw-data 2.4-2.6 sigma is the honest figure. One sentence converts the omission into a demonstration of charity.

holes_found.description: 'epoch-folded at each site's known contact times' is loose terminology — epoch-folding denotes folding periodic signals over many cycles; a single eclipse gives one event per site, so the operation described is coherent cross-instrument stacking/alignment. The sqrt(8) ~ 2.8x noise suppression also idealizes: it assumes uncorrelated equal-variance noise across sites and an equal-amplitude coherent signal, while coverage scaling (which our own paragraph 3 develops) makes the expected kappa-pulse amplitude site-dependent, and regional atmospheric loading introduces common-mode noise.
holes_found.recommendation: Replace 'epoch-folded' with 'coherently stacked (aligned at each site's known contact times)' and hedge the floor as 'of order 0.4-0.7 uGal under standard uncorrelated-noise assumptions'. The conclusion is robust to both nits; the wording shouldn't gift a pedant the opening.

holes_found.description: Author-role imprecision in the new paragraph: 'the same lead author's 2002 reanalysis' — Wang Qian-shen led the 2000 PRD paper but is SECOND author of Yang & Wang 2002 (Crossref: Yang first, Wang second); and 'his co-author's 2003 follow-up' — Yang is second author of Van Flandern & Yang 2003 (Van Flandern first). The narrative point (the original team walked the signal back) is fully sound, but both possessives over-attribute leadership and are nitpickable against Crossref metadata. WIN-011 already uses the safer 'the same team's reanalysis' phrasing.
holes_found.recommendation: Align with WIN-011's phrasing: 'the same team's 2002 reanalysis' and 'a 2003 follow-up co-authored by the same Yang'. Zero substance lost, nitpick surface removed.

stronger_arguments.description: Wang et al. 2000's own Table I is unexploited ammunition: of 10,080 measurements across the eclipse week, 9,948 (98.7%) deviate <2 uGal from the mean — the instrument's own data distribution shows that 6-7 uGal excursions are ~0.4% tail events on a +/-3-4 uGal band, i.e., the founding anomaly is statistically unremarkable on the instrument's own week-long record. This is a sharper quantitative kill than the 2.4-2.6 sigma framing and comes from the same primary source.

kernel_of_truth.description: The dome cites a real campaign with a real result: the 2009 East Asian eclipse SG/spring-gravimeter campaign exists, recorded through all contact phases, and found no eclipse gravity anomaly (wins.json:WIN-014.detail_evidence, quoting doi:10.6038/cjg20130306's conclusion verbatim). The defender's instrument-class point that EXP-618 now answers is also genuinely true as far as it goes: seven of eight instruments were spring gravimeters with floors far above an SG's (arXiv:1003.4947 full text confirms the LCR class carries a +/-3-4 uGal raw band), so 'the network might have missed a small signal' is not a fabricated worry.
kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: A null only 'confirms' the dome if the dome's own published coupling predicted null — it didn't: kappa = 1.677 nT/uGal (monitor.py line 478, verified live this run) times the dome's own WIN-068-cited 5-15 nT ensemble (wins.json:WIN-014.detail_evidence, Kim & Chang 2018 DOI 10.1016/j.asr.2018.01.022) predicts 3-9 uGal, and the campaign's floor — on ANY reading of the instrument numbers, sourced or conservative — sits below that prediction. And the sensitivity escape deletes kappa's own denominator first (wins.json:WIN-014.detail_evidence, EXP-618 paragraph: D-122 at 2-3 uGal precision cannot establish 6.5 uGal if eight stacked instruments cannot bound 3-9). The dome keeps the null or keeps kappa; it cannot keep both.

advocate_mode.best_defense: A fair-minded defender's strongest line after EXP-618: 'The 2013 CJG authors themselves conclude the supposed anomaly cannot be detected with actual observation conditions and instrument performance — the people holding the residuals classified their own campaign as sensitivity-limited. Your review overrides the primary source's own self-assessment with an unsourced 1-2 uGal spring floor and a back-of-envelope sqrt(8) stacking argument the campaign never performed. If the campaign's authors say their network could not detect the anomaly class in question, the null is an absence of evidence, and WIN-014 reduces to an unfalsified — not refuted — claim.' This is potent because it weaponizes our own quoted conclusion sentence and attacks exactly the two uncited/idealized figures flagged in holes 0 and 2.
advocate_mode.preemptive_recommendation: Implement holes 0-2: derive the floor bound exclusively from the defense's own sources (Wang 2000's +/-3-4 uGal band stacked to ~1.1-1.4 uGal, still 2-8x below prediction; SG-053 at 0.1-1 uGal wherever it sits) and add the existing dilemma sentence's logic explicitly to the stacking passage: IF the network truly could not bound 3-9 uGal, the dome's 'CONFIRMED' label dies first, since confirming a null requires exactly the sensitivity the defense denies. The dilemma already exists in our text; wiring it to the instrument numbers closes the last rhetorical gap.

deeper_analysis: EXP-618 is the right structural move: it closes the one defender retreat (network insensitivity) that the c12-era dilemma sentence handled only abstractly, and it closes it with the strongest possible shape — a tu quoque grounded in the defense's own founding instrument. The full-text verification this run strengthens it further: every instrument figure EXP-618 attributes to Wang et al. 2000 is verbatim-accurate (D-122, 2-3 uGal, +/-3-4 band, both dip values), which is exactly the standard this site is held to. The two moderates are both 'last-mile' rhetorical gaps, not substance: (1) the only number in the stacking argument NOT sourced to the defense's own literature is the 1-2 uGal spring floor — and it happens to sit in visible tension with the +/-3-4 figure three sentences later; recomputing the bound from the defense's own worst-case numbers costs nothing and makes the argument self-sealing; (2) the smoothed-curve sigmas (3.8-4.9) are in the same TeX file a motivated defender will read, so quoting only 2.4-2.6 invites a cherry-picking charge that one disposal clause prevents. The c13 TLDR patches landed cleanly (tldr_evidence now correctly scopes per-instrument floors; double-attribution artifact gone; tldr_verdict's added 'attributed their original signal to weather' sentence is accurate to the 2013 abstract as carried from c12). Three c13 minors remain open as ISS-2720/2721/2722 and are restated as carry-overs per PROP-026 M3. Verdict robustly holds: Refuted by Data at 0.93 — the dilemma structure (null refutes kappa; sensitivity-limit voids 'CONFIRMED') is now armored on both horns.

EXP-618's new paragraph is verbatim-accurate against the Wang et al. 2000 TeX full text (fetched this run — D-122, 2-3 uGal precision, +/-3-4 band, both dips confirmed) and all new arithmetic verifies. 8 holes: 2 moderate (uncited 1-2 uGal spring floor that visibly tensions with the +/-3-4 figure our own paragraph quotes — fix by recomputing the stacked bound from Wang's own numbers, ~1.1-1.4 uGal, still 2-8x below prediction; unmentioned smoothed-curve sigmas 3.8-4.9 in the same paper — one disposal clause), 6 minor (epoch-folding terminology, author-role possessives vs Crossref order, kappa-cluster vise missing the newly neutralized defense class, plus 3 carry-overs ISS-2720/2721/2722 restated per M3). Bonus ammunition logged in stronger_arguments: Wang Table I shows 98.7% of the week's 10,080 readings deviate <2 uGal — the founding anomaly is a 0.4% tail event on the instrument's own record.
